description.en: Down to earth but with a weakness for luxury, a taurus is reliable and solid as a rock. Living in the here and now, it makes the best out of everyday life instead of dreaming up castles in the air. This pendant is available in 18 karat gold and sterling silver. Dimensions: approximately 21 x 15 x 2 mm.
